title: How to Get TikTok Shop Samples: Creator and Seller Guide
summary: Learn how eligible TikTok Shop creators request samples, what content obligations apply, and how sellers review, ship, and track sample requests.
body_markdown:
## Frequently asked questions


### Can anyone get free samples on TikTok Shop?


No. Access depends on market, account eligibility, creator history, seller settings, inventory, and collaboration type. Check the current offer in Creator Center.


### Can a creator with zero followers request a public free sample?


The current US sample guide does not support that promise. It states more than 5,000 followers for sample application or purchase and applies a recent-sales rule to public free samples.


### Does a seller have to approve an eligible creator?


No. Sellers can set thresholds and approve, reject, or not act on a request. Product and sample inventory also matter.


### What happens after a sample arrives?


The creator should test it and meet the exact shoppable-content obligation and deadline shown in Manage Samples, including the correct product link and disclosure.


### What is the difference between a free and refundable sample?


A free sample has no product purchase upfront. A refundable sample is purchased first and refunded only if the creator meets the displayed criteria.
